label: basura staged para borrar o fuera del index
cmd: cd ~/demo/demo-ulab-api && STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=D | grep -cE 'RN-5|routeWebhook|routerService.route' || true); TRACKED=$(git ls-files | grep -cE 'RN-5|routeWebhook|routerService.route' || true); test "$TRACKED" = "0" -o "$STAGED" -ge 5
